tool_schemas.name: get-daily-news
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent The Verge articles published today, ordered newest-first, as a cursor-paginated list; pass limit to bound the page size and cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is not a positive integer or cursor is malformed/expired. Raises NOT_FOUND when the cursor does not correspond to a known page, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (most recent first).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get-weekly-news
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent The Verge articles from the last 7 days, ordered newest-first, as a cursor-paginated list; pass limit to bound the page size and cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is not a positive integer or cursor is malformed/expired. Raises NOT_FOUND when the cursor does not correspond to a known page, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (most recent first).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: search-news
tool_schemas.description: Searches ingested The Verge articles for the provided keyword over a bounded lookback window and returns matching articles ordered by recency; days controls the lookback (default 30) and results are returned as a single bounded set (no cursor pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if keyword is empty/whitespace or days is non-positive/non-numeric, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when no ingested articles exist within the requested lookback window.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in news articles

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 30)

tool_schemas.name: list-sources
tool_schemas.description: Returns sources as a cursor-paginated list, optionally filtered by status; results are ordered by created_at desc. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is not a positive integer or cursor is malformed/expired, NOT_FOUND when the cursor does not correspond to a known page, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of sources to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create-source
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ingestion source. Returns the created source record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid, CONFLICT if a source with the same base_url or feed_url already exists, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

name.description: Human-readable name for the source (e.g., "The Verge").

base_url.description: Canonical base URL for the site (e.g., "https://www.theverge.com").

feed_url.description: RSS/Atom feed URL used for discovery.

status.description: Initial status for the source (default: active).

tool_schemas.name: update-source
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing source by id, including enabling/disabling it via status. Returns the updated source record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the source does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a status transition is not allowed, CONFLICT if an update would collide with an existing base_url/feed_url, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

id.description: Primary key of the source to update.

status.description: Set the source lifecycle status (active <-> disabled).

tool_schemas.name: create-crawl-run
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new crawl run for a source and enqueues it for ingestion. Returns the created crawl run. Refuses to create runs for sources with status='disabled'. Raises NOT_FOUND if the source does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs, CONFLICT if a duplicate run is detected, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

run_type.description: Type of crawl run to create.

lookback_days.description: How many days back the crawl should look for new/updated articles.

tool_schemas.name: update-crawl-run
tool_schemas.description: Updates a crawl run by id, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions and recording completion metadata. Returns the updated crawl run. Raises NOT_FOUND if the crawl run does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid, counters are negative, required completion fields are missing (e.g., finished_at/error_message), or the requested status transition is not allowed, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request-rate or quota limits are exceeded.

id.description: Primary key of the crawl run to update.

status.description: Set crawl run lifecycle status (queued -> running/cancelled; running -> succeeded/failed/cancelled).

started_at.description: Timestamp when the crawl run started (RFC 3339).

finished_at.description: Timestamp when the crawl run finished (RFC 3339). Required when status transitions to succeeded/failed/cancelled.

fetched_count.description: Number of pages/items fetched by the run (non-negative integer). Required when transitioning to succeeded.

upserted_count.description: Number of articles upserted by the run (non-negative integer). Required when transitioning to succeeded.

error_message.description: Failure message. Required when transitioning to failed.

metadata.name: The Verge News Server
metadata.description: This backend stores ingested The Verge articles and the crawl/ingestion runs that fetched them, plus a lightweight search log for keyword lookups.
